issues.detail: R4 has uncertain=false, but its spec_quote only states that predict_history is the register value; it does not provide verbatim evidence for the no-update hold condition.
issues.spec_evidence: predict_history is the value of the branch history register.

issues.detail: R2 marks the misprediction load formula uncertain and lists alternative truncations, but S01 (32-bit shift register), S02 (LSB is youngest), and S03 (concatenate train_history with train_taken) determine discarding the oldest MSB. The uncertainty flag and alternatives are inconsistent with the spec.
issues.spec_evidence: This is the history before the mispredicted branch (train_history) concatenated with the actual result of the branch (train_taken).

issues.detail: The global mid-cycle convention says mid-cycle input changes do not change already sampled predict_history, but R1's asynchronous reset must force predict_history to 0 immediately when areset goes high mid-cycle.
issues.spec_evidence: areset is a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset that resets the history counter to zero.
